title: JERSEY BOLLYWOOD AFTERPARTY @LAKE CHATEAU
description: Bollywood nightclub party in the heart of Jersey @Lake Chateau Banquets ft, DJ Browny! (Afterparty for The White Garba on Oct 17th)

Bollywood nightclub party in the heart of Jersey @Lake Chateau Banquets ft, DJ Browny! (Afterparty for The White Garba on Oct 17th)

About this Event

🔥 Bollywood Saturday with DJ BrownyThe Garba may end, but the night is just getting started!
After an unforgettable evening of outdoor lakeside Garba under the stars, we take the celebration indoors at 10:00 PM for a high-energy Bollywood Afterparty with DJ Browny.
Get ready for a full-on Bollywood party featuring the biggest dance anthems, crowd favorites, high-energy beats, and nonstop music to keep you dancing into the night. 💃🔥
✨ DJ Browny Live
🎶 Biggest Bollywood & dance hits
🔥 High-energy Dandiya party
🕺 Indoor late-night celebration
🥂 Party vibes from 10:00 PM – 2:00 AM
🔞 21+
Already have your Garba tickets? You’re in!
Your Garba ticket includes complimentary access to the Bollywood Afterparty.
Not joining us for Garba? Afterparty-only tickets are also available.
🌅 5:00 PM – 9:30 PM: Outdoor Fusion & Bollywood Garba (Garba tickets)
🔥 10:00 PM – 2:00 AM: Indoor Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty
Come for the Garba. Stay for the Bollywood. Dance all the way into the night!
